title: Free Recall with Closed-Loop Stimulation at Encoding (Encoding Classifier)
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial electrophysiology recordings from a delayed free recall task with closed-loop electrical stimulation delivered during encoding, guided by a classifier trained on encoding data. Participants studied lists of visually presented words, performed arithmetic distractor tasks, and then freely recalled the words. Data were collected at multiple clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania, and represent a closed-loop stimulation extension of the FR1 and FR2 free recall datasets.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded during a delayed free recall task with word encoding, distractor arithmetic, and free recall phases. An L2 logistic regression classifier trained on FR1 session data predicted subsequent recall from spectral power features (Morlet wavelet transform, 8 frequencies 3-180 Hz) computed from bipolar recordings 0-1366 ms post-word presentation, after removing line noise with a Butterworth band-stop filter. Classifier performance was validated via leave-one-session-out cross-validation with permutation testing. During closed-loop sessions, stimulation was delivered to a single electrode pair based on real-time classifier output relative to a training-derived median threshold, with stimulation parameters (anode/cathode, amplitude, frequency, pulse width, pulse count) recorded in behavioral event files.
